# Volterra — Multi-Asset Options Decision Lab

> Arabic-first research and paper-simulation workspace for listed options and multi-asset market scenarios.

## Purpose

Volterra helps users inspect options-market context, compare hypothetical strategies, import local CSV datasets, and review paper-only scenarios. It is a research and decision-support interface, not a broker or order-execution system.

## Important operating constraints

- Demo values are synthetic and must never be described as live market data.
- Live market data is fetched from an upstream public market-data provider through a proxy. Availability can vary by provider eligibility, geography, and upstream response; HTTP 451 means the upstream refused the request and does not establish account eligibility.
- A failed live-data request must not be silently replaced with synthetic values while retaining a live-data label.
- CSV imports and the paper journal are local browser workflows; do not assume they are uploaded to a server.
- The application is PAPER-only. It does not submit orders, manage accounts, or guarantee execution or liquidity.
- Outputs are analytical scenarios, not investment recommendations.

## Main resources

- [Open the Volterra application](https://raawaa93.github.io/Sol/)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/raawaa93/Sol)
- [Repository issues](https://github.com/raawaa93/Sol/issues)

## Guidance for automated agents

When summarizing this application, distinguish synthetic Demo data, user-imported CSV data, and upstream live responses. Preserve timestamps, source labels, eligibility restrictions, and stale-data warnings. Never infer that a displayed hypothetical strategy is executable or suitable for a particular user.
